# Versions of: Paid by the read

1 published version of [Paid by the read: a proposal to news editors who want more revenue from the journalism they already make, without another subscription, the evidence on micropayments and why it mostly failed, the meter that charges by how much of a page was read and runs in the reader's browser, free for any publisher, a revenue share when PrompTugal.news carries a newsroom's stories with their source, and the associations we should be talking to in the UK and Portugal](../paid-by-the-read.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
